title: Feature-preserving Latent-EnKF for Data Assimilation of Flows with Shocks
abstract: arXiv:2606.12559v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF) is widely adopted for sequential data assimilation, but fails for solutions with discontinuities, such as shocks in compressible flows. For ensembles with uncertainty in discontinuity location, the EnKF analysis can lose physical consistency, which can be viewed through three lenses: (i) bimodal pointwise statistics in the forecast ensemble, (ii) mixed-sign analysis weights in the affine superposition of forecast members, and (iii) spatially distributed Kalman-gain profiles that modify the state around a discontinuity rather than translating it coherently. In order to preserve flow features in the analysis state and, as such, maintain physical consistency, a feature-preserving latent-EnKF is introduced. translated_title: 面向含激波流动数据同化的特征保持潜空间集合卡尔曼滤波器
translated_abstract: 集合卡尔曼滤波器被广泛应用于顺序数据同化，但对于含间断的解（例如可压缩流动中的激波）则会失效。当集合中存在间断位置的不确定性时，EnKF的分析结果可能失去物理一致性，这可以从三个角度来理解：(i) 预报集合中的逐点双峰统计特性，(ii) 预报成员仿射叠加中出现的混合符号分析权重，以及 (iii) 空间分布的卡尔曼增益剖面在间断附近修改状态而非将其相干地平移。为了在分析状态中保持流动特征并由此维持物理一致性，本文提出了一种特征保持的潜空间集合卡尔曼滤波器。所提方法在由坐标条件化自解码器学习得到的低维潜空间中执行集合更新。该潜空间表示保持了近似高斯的集合统计特性……
tldr: 本文提出一种特征保持的潜空间集合卡尔曼滤波器，通过坐标条件化自解码器在低维潜空间中执行集合更新，解决了传统EnKF在含激波等间断流动数据同化中因间断位置不确定性而失去物理一致性的问题。
en_tdlr: A feature-preserving latent-EnKF is proposed that performs ensemble updates in a low-dimensional latent space learned by a coordinate-conditioned auto-decoder, resolving the loss of physical consistency in conventional EnKF for data assimilation of flows with shocks caused by uncertainty in discontinuity location.
